title: Restore Quarto Callout Blocks, Tabsets, and Code Annotation Styling in pkgdown Sites
text: pkgdown renders Quarto (.qmd) files theme: "none" minimal: TRUE can supply CSS instead Quarto’s. Thus, currently following broken using .qmd files: Callouts blocks degrade plain, untyped blockquote. Tabsets get actively mangled. Code annotations keep HTML/classes lose JS makes interactive. quartofix fixes . Two approaches implemented: quartofix(): Rewrites broken things Quarto’s native callout markup, links small vendored CSS/JS bundle tabsets code annotations work without pulling Quarto’s full asset bundle. quartofix2(): Runs quarto render .qmd files callout blocks tabsets. Code annotations handled way quartofix(), since markup already survives pkgdown’s render intact, vendored JS/CSS bundle needs linked . patches together generated .html pkgdown. move callouts tabsets (don’t run code (since might need previous code)) seperate temp .qmd file. cost rendering essentially 0, potentially decent speedup.
